lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: (Oh, by the time Invoque is hit, Tiermet has to come out. Wow, can’t you see it? Ha, it’s okay if you can’t see it.)

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Invoke no longer has to order monsters to mess up the village. We must be strict.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Probably not… ?

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: That's it. Wow, it feels familiar on the inside. Shall we stop by for a moment? Let's go!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait! Zoe, let’s go together!
(As the two hurried inside the nest, Invoke cautiously opened one eye.)

lines.speaker: 인보크
lines.text: You went, right?

lines.speaker: 인보크
lines.text: Ha, there is none.
(Invoke sighs and stands up.)

lines.speaker: 인보크
lines.text: The conqueror of the earth and sky who brings fear and despair to all living things, the ruler of the flames, the name that everyone praises!

lines.speaker: 인보크
lines.text: Invoke!

lines.speaker: 인보크
lines.text: Ugh… . It hurts here and there. What are they saying when they suddenly come in? Phew, it's not about saving face.

lines.speaker: 인보크
lines.text: From now on, I must tell my descendants never to touch the flower spirit. But what is that human?

lines.speaker: 인보크
lines.text: By the way, am I calling a monster? Bow of Iris? What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: 인보크
lines.text: Now, wait… . Have I been wronged?
(A boy is standing at the end of the nest that followed Zoe. The boy appears to have recognized Zoe and greets him with a bright smile.)
Hey, it's Zoe!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Oh, I think I know Zoe well. Is this the kid Zoe was talking about?)

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Muwen!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Zoe Seeing your face brighten, I think it’s true.)

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Muwen, you! Where have you been and what have you been doing all this time!?

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: Hey, I should have left this behind... . it hurts.
(Zoe is holding onto Muwen's ball and stretching it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Zoe, how about we talk about that first?

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Ah, I developed a habit without even realizing it. Missing, Muwen.

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: I'm fine. More than that, I'm glad Zoe is safe. Thank goodness~. I'm glad~

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Now, wait! Eh, eh.
(Muwen laughs, grabs Zoe's hand, and starts spinning around. Zoe seems to be used to this situation, too, sighing and spinning around together.)
(After a while, the eyes of Muwen and %s finally meet.)

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: Ah! You are %s!! I heard the story!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, do you know me?

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: %s, please talk to me comfortably. I gave permission.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, yes.

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Muwen, you! %s Did you hear the story?

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: Yeah. I heard it from Sister Ashe. I told you that I punished that scary king goblin.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that… .

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: You can either wait there for Gramo or do it. What did you come here for? Dangerously... .

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: Because it’s obvious that Zoe will come here.

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Phew… . Baby, there is no fear.

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: Well, I'm glad we met like this!

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: What a good thing! Get rid of this Mundi! Tell me everything about where you have been and what you have been doing. Did you understand?

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: Got it. don't worry… . By the way, %s, can I hear it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine, so please feel free to talk.

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: %s, sorry. I have something to say to my Muwen. I'll talk to you over there for a moment, so please wait.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah, I'll wait.
(After finishing the story, Zoe and Muwen slowly walk out.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is the story over?

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Uh, it's over. I'm going to go with Muwen.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, why?

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: I also want to go find Iris, but I don't think I should leave here now.

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: I feel something very ominous here right now... .

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: Zoe, can’t you feel Zoe?

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: It's not just a menacing feeling like Invoke. The same fear as when meeting the devil... .

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Muwen, that… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Fear….)

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Where in the evil dragon's nest is there something like that?

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: You said you were looking for %s, Iris, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah. I have Iris… .
(I haven’t even finished telling the story, but Zoe comes out.)

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Hey, %s… . Iris Can I ask you to help me find it?

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: Please do me a favor too. %s. Actually, I also wanted to go look for Iris, but I don't know if I can be of help now.

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: That's what you say, Muwen. Why don't you know how helpful you are?

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: Thanks, Zoe. Still, it’s harder than me to find Iris… .
(Zoe looks at %s's face.)

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: I guess %s… . I thought %s's journey would find Iris.

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: I think the same thing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not sure, but I feel like I have to go my own way.

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: We will solve the problem here on our own and think of it as training.

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Hamo.

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: Then, won't we meet again someday?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Someday... .
(I can feel some kind of trust in Muwen’s words.)

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: If you go to Grammo Elias, please give our regards to Ignate and if you go to Yonggyeong, Xiaowei. It’s been a while since I’ve seen Ignate, but… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, then I'll go ahead and look for Iris. See you later.

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Thank you. And I hope we can meet again someday.

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: Goodbye, %s.

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: Oh, it's already going. It's a bit disappointing... .

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Muwen, you said. Iris Looking for... . Ah, it's a child. It's a child. I'll do that later. Son of man, I will find it.

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: Yeah, maybe that's... .

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Let go of trivial worries. Iris is worried.

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: Okay, Zoe. Then let's go.
(As Zoe and Muwen go outside, someone who was watching this scene slowly walks out.)
Hmph. I've always felt this, but that kid has a good sense of touch. I don't know if I survived because of that touch... .
What kind of facial expression will the trapped guy make if he finds out that these little guys are alive?
I'm going crazy with curiosity. The look on the face of a guy who knew nothing and suffered after learning the truth was truly thrilling.
Don't look at it that way.
Don't look at me like that!
They look at me with disdain despite being someone who can't do anything anyway.
Ugh, it will never go your way. Get out of my head! Disappear!!
It can't go on like this. Everything, including the ‘thing’ that old man said… .
I will erase you from this world!!
Ahaha… . Ahahahaha… . Ahahahahaha!!

steps.name: Let's Go to Elias
steps.objective: After looking around the street in front of the monument at "Elias", go to [Ignate].

lines.text: (As you enter along the well-maintained path, you see many people.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Here is Elias… .
(The feel of a city that retains both antiquity and sophistication is majestic.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wow. This is a place like this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I suddenly feel strange...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Stop doing this and go to the instructor Ignate.

lines.speaker: 이그나트
lines.text: You were with Miss Zoe at that time... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: 이그나트
lines.text: But why am I alone?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (They say that they met Zoe and Muwen and then parted ways to travel separately.)

lines.speaker: 이그나트
lines.text: I see. If you left to find something to do again like then, %s… , where are you going?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think it should go to Yonggyeong. Zoe said he knew someone in Yonggyeong.

lines.speaker: 이그나트
lines.text: Yonggyeong... . It is now a provincial city in the Elias kingdom, but long ago it was the center of a large empire. It's quite a beautiful place, so there's probably a lot to see here and there.

lines.speaker: 이그나트
lines.text: If you need help, find an instructor in the city you're going to. The Adventurer Association is helping Adventurer by contacting them through dedicated communication.

lines.speaker: 이그나트
lines.text: %s, good luck.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. Then I'll go there.
